name: connections
summary: How pipes, cables and chutes connect, from the game's own ends and networks: one thing's ends, or a network's members (30 per page) with filters and a summary; summarize counts them by prefab. Read only.

help.text: Three forms. reference_id: a pipe, cable, chute or device's ends. network_id with kind (pipe, cable or chute): the network's members, pieces first then devices, paged. min and max alone: every cable, pipe and chute piece in the box with an open end, across all networks, each with its network_id and open_ends (kind narrows it; at most a 32 m cube). A big network reads best with summarize true (topic summarize) or an area.
help.keys: thing {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name}, position {x, y, z}, rotation {facing, up, euler}, own_network {kind, id}, color {index, name, is_default}, ends [{index, type, type_name, role, role_name, position, network, connected}], count, network {kind, id}, summary, members [{reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, member, position, color, open_ends}], structure_count, device_count, by_prefab [{prefab_name, display_name, member, count, colors}], devices, open_ends, open_end_count, offset, limit, total, has_more, resolved_networks.

ends.text: thing, position, rotation {facing, up, euler} (as place_structure takes it; facing and up null off the grid's axes), own_network ({kind, id} of a piece, else null) and ends [{index, type (Pipe, PipeLiquid, Power, Data, PowerAndData, Chute, Elevator, LandingPad, LaunchPad, RoboticArmRail), type_name, role (None, Input, Input2, Output, Output2, Waste), role_name, position, network ({kind, id}: a piece's own at every end; for a device the network attached there, null when none), connected (everything attached at that end)}]. Network ids come from ends[].network.id.

network.summary: The network form, its filters and summary.
network.text: members [{reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, member, position, color (as paint reads it; left out when none)}] with count, structure_count, device_count, paging, network {kind, id} and summary. Filters, applied before paging (total counts the members kept): prefab_contains, open_ends_only (each member then lists open_ends), and an area: min and max (a box) or near with radius_m. Pipe summary: content, volume_l, pressure_kpa, temperature_k, total_mol, liquid_volume_l, gases (null on a multiplayer client). Cable summary, from the last power tick as the Cable Analyser shows it: required_w, potential_w, actual_w, shortfall_w, lowest_cable_max_w, lowest_fuse_break_w, overloaded, fuse_overloaded, cable_count, fuse_count. Chute summary: member_count. Broken pieces touching the network: subtopic broken_neighbours.

broken_neighbours.summary: Broken pieces touching the network that it does not hold.
broken_neighbours.text: A burst or broken piece stays in its cell, joined at its ends, but need not be on its network, so members and the counts do not show it, and the member's end it meets is not open. Both network forms walk every member's ends, as the game attaches them, whatever the filters keep, for broken pieces (and broken pieces beyond them) that are not on the network. The members form then adds a warning; summarize adds broken_neighbour_count (0: none), and when there are any a warning and broken_neighbours [{reference_id, prefab_name, position, pipe_burst, network (the one it is on itself, null for none), touches (the member it is attached to)}], the first one.

summarize.summary: What is on a network in one reply.
summarize.text: Network form with summarize true: by_prefab [{prefab_name, display_name, member, count, colors {name: count}}] (most first), devices and open_ends (members with an end nothing is attached at, each with open_ends), each list up to limit (default 10), with structure_count, device_count, open_end_count, network and summary. prefab_contains and the area apply first; offset and open_ends_only do not go with it.

refusals.text: not_connectable: not a pipe, cable, chute or device, so it has no connection ends. thing_not_found and network_not_found: nothing has that id.

reference_id.description: A pipe, cable, chute or device: its ends.
A device or piece on the network.

network_id.description: A network (with kind) or a handle on it: its members (see networks).

kind.description: Kind of network_id; box form: only this kind.

prefab_contains.description: Only members whose prefab name holds this, any case.

summarize.description: Network form: counts by prefab and colour, devices and open ends instead of members. Default false.

open_ends_only.description: Network form: only members with an end nothing is attached at. Default false.

min.description: Box corner [x, y, z]; with max. Alone: open ends in it.

near.description: Network form: a point, [x, y, z] in metres; with radius_m.

radius_m.description: Network form: with near, up to 1000.

limit.description: Members per page; default 30, box form 25; summarize: devices and open ends listed, default 10.

offset.description: Network form: members to skip (see paging).

x-paging.order: network form: the network's pieces as the game lists them (its structure list), then its devices, each thing once; box form: cables, then pipes, then chutes, each by y, z, x
